_about: The 'bash' column is the daemon's classify_failure with SW_BUN pointing at nothing, so it is the bash regex alone (the test harness sets SW_BUN). Its auth alternatives mirror the TS auth rule, and its contamination rule mirrors the TS contamination rule, so a host without Bun does not retry an auth or contamination failure. Rows changed to match the regex: 'invalid api key provided', 'OAuth token revoked', 'OAuth token is invalid' (auth_error), and the two contamination texts (contamination).
